I answered Marcus in a thread reply on his #north-team message. The main contact for the door 6 duplicate arrivals at Quarrendon Freight Lines is **Thea Ramaswell**.

I got this from Dana's Aug 20, 2025 post in #north-team, which Marcus can see. She wrote that Thea had flagged duplicate arrivals on door 6 again during the morning shift. According to that thread, a driver checked in at the kiosk and then dispatch added him manually as well. A contact is an operational fact, not a finance figure, so it was fine to share in the channel.
